stories.title: Migranti, l'appello di Richard Gere: "Basta detenzioni e deportazioni, serve umanità"

en.title: Migrants, Richard Gere's appeal: "Stop detentions and deportations, humanity is needed"
en.summary: Actor Richard Gere urges an end to migrant detentions and deportations, arguing that fear has replaced compassion and people are being reduced to statistics rather than treated as individuals.

stories.title: La Corte d'Assise di Bergamo rigetta la richiesta di nuove analisi sui reperti

en.title: Bergamo Court of Assizes rejects request for new analysis on evidence
en.summary: A court in Bergamo has denied a defense request for additional DNA analysis on evidence from a mixed blood sample, with the defense team announcing they will appeal the decision.

stories.title: Migranti, Salvini dopo il video di Richard Gere: “Fai l’attore, non dare lezioni agli italiani”

en.title: Migrants, Salvini responds to Richard Gere video: "Act, don't lecture Italians"
en.summary: Italian politician Matteo Salvini criticizes Hollywood actor Richard Gere for recording a video supporting ActionAid's migrant advocacy campaign.

stories.title: Caso Flydubai, la confessione del copilota: “Volevo il martirio per vendicare Gaza”

en.title: Flydubai case, copilot's confession: "I wanted martyrdom to avenge Gaza"
en.summary: A 29-year-old Omani copilot has confessed to attempting to crash a passenger flight with 174 people aboard, stating his motive was connected to Gaza.

stories.title: Richard Gere attacca il modello italiano sui migranti, Salvini: “Radical chic, faccia l’attore”

en.title: Richard Gere attacks Italian migration model, Salvini: "Radical chic, be an actor"
en.summary: Actor Richard Gere criticized Italy's migration agreement with Albania, stating that fear is replacing compassion. League leader Salvini responded dismissively, suggesting Gere lives in luxury and wanted to testify against him.

stories.title: Italia-Turchia 3-1, Scamacca, Calafiori e Pio Esposito firmano la vittoria in Nations League

en.title: Italy-Turkey 3-1, Scamacca, Calafiori and Pio Esposito seal Nations League victory
en.summary: Italy defeated Turkey 3-1 in a Nations League match in Bologna, with goals from Scamacca, Calafiori, and Pio Esposito. Donnarumma made crucial saves late in the match as Italy moved to second place behind France.

stories.title: Italia U21 straripante: 6-2 alla Polonia e pass diretto per gli Europei. Gol di Ndour da 70 metri

en.title: Italy U21 dominant: 6-2 victory over Poland and direct passage to Euros. Ndour scores from 70 meters
en.summary: Italy's under-21 team overwhelmingly defeated Poland 6-2, securing automatic qualification for the European Championship. Ndour scored twice, including a remarkable long-range goal, while Koleosho, Lipani, Fini, and Cherubini also scored.

stories.title: Il copilota, 'l'ho fatto per vendicare Gaza, volevo morire da martire'

en.title: The copilot, 'I did it to avenge Gaza, I wanted to die as a martyr'
en.summary: A copilot confessed to interrogators in the United Arab Emirates that he committed an act to avenge Gaza and sought to die as a martyr.

stories.title: Calcio: 6-2 alla Polonia, l'Italia Under 21 si qualifica agli Europei 2027

en.title: Football: Italy Under 21 qualifies for 2027 Euros with 6-2 win over Poland
en.summary: Italy's Under 21 team secured qualification for the 2027 European Championship with a decisive 6-2 victory over Poland in Pescara, topping their qualification group by goal difference.

stories.title: Europei U21. Qualificazioni, Cherubini fa tutto da solo e chiude il "set": Italia-Polonia 6-2

en.title: U21 Euros Qualifiers: Cherubini scores to seal Italy's 6-2 victory over Poland
en.summary: Cherubini scored a decisive goal in Italy's 6-2 qualifying victory over Poland for the U21 European Championship, with the player executing a skillful move to complete the match.

stories.title: Yara, giudici rigettano la richiesta di nuove analisi. I genitori: “Evitare un caso Garlasco 2”

en.title: Yara case: judges reject request for new forensic analysis. Parents: "Avoid another Garlasco case"
en.summary: The Bergamo Court of Assizes rejected a request for additional forensic investigations submitted by Massimo Bossetti's legal team, while the victim's family opposed the new inquiries.

stories.title: Ranucci sospeso dalla Rai per 10 giorni, dalle mail a Lavitola agli ingressi in azienda: le contestazioni

en.title: Ranucci suspended by Rai for 10 days, from emails to Lavitola to company access: the charges
en.summary: Rai suspended journalist Ranucci for ten days following disciplinary charges issued by the broadcaster's ethics committee in September.

stories.title: Ericsson, ritirati i 131 licenziamenti a Genova dopo l’intervento di Meloni

en.title: Ericsson withdraws 131 layoffs in Genoa following Meloni's intervention
en.summary: Ericsson reversed its decision to lay off 131 workers in Genoa, instead offering exit incentives lasting 48 months and relocating staff to other facilities of the Swedish multinational.

stories.title: Nucleare pulito, consegnato l’ultimo settore Ue del reattore a fusione Iter

en.title: Clean nuclear, last EU sector of Iter fusion reactor delivered
en.summary: Fusion for Energy, along with Ansaldo Nucleare, Westinghouse Electric Company, and Walter Tosto, completed a major sector component for the Iter fusion reactor project.

stories.title: Electrolux ritira i licenziamenti unilaterali: nuovo piano con incentivi all’esodo e ammortizzatori sociali

en.title: Electrolux withdraws unilateral layoffs: new plan with exit incentives and social safety nets
en.summary: Electrolux has withdrawn unilateral dismissal notices and presented a revised plan featuring exit incentives and social protections. Minister Urso scheduled additional technical meetings and confirmed EU support for Italy's negotiation strategy.

stories.title: Pelle umana stampata in 3D, a Bio System Lab il Premio Digithon

en.title: Human skin 3D printed at Bio System Lab wins Digithon Prize
en.summary: Bio System Lab, a startup from Treviso, won a major prize for its patent on vascularized human skin produced through 3D printing, described as the world's first of its kind.

stories.title: Ex Ilva, la Corte d’Appello di Milano conferma il blocco degli altiforni

en.title: Ex Ilva, Milan Court of Appeal confirms blast furnace shutdown
en.summary: Milan's Court of Appeal rejected a second suspension request regarding the decree blocking the hot area operations at the former Ilva steelworks in Taranto, upholding the blast furnace shutdown.
